articles.summary: Vancouver, B.C. – Teck Resources Limited (TSX: TECK.A and TECK.B, NYSE: TECK) (“Teck”) has released its North America Truth and Reconciliation Action Plan, setting measurable commitments to respond to Indigenous priorities, strengthen relationships with Indigenous Peoples, and integrate Truth and Reconciliation as a guiding framework for our activities across North America.
articles.title: Teck Releases North America Truth and Reconciliation Action Plan
